{"decision":"reflow2's own decomposition is the functional systems a design-graph tool IS — foundation, vocabulary, store, coherence-loop, human-channel, time-history, intake, agent-surface, documentation — with the Rust modules re-parented under them as implementation. The as-built crate grouping (reflow2-core / -mcp / kit) is retired from the as-designed view.

CORRECTED 2026-08-02: this said "the seven functional systems" and named seven. There were EIGHT — `sys:documentation` joined later under `dec:documentation-has-no-operational-coupling`, which accepts that documentation is part of the product while having no operational coupling, so it forms an island the detectors are told to expect. The choice this decision records was unchanged; only its enumeration had gone stale, which is why that was a correction on the record rather than a superseding decision (`dec:reopen-supersedes` governs reversals, not arithmetic). Found by re-measuring a claim rather than re-reading it: the decision's prose said seven while `scan_nodes` said eight.

AMENDED 2026-08-20, and THIS ONE IS NOT ARITHMETIC. There are now NINE. `sys:foundation` was CREATED under `dec:the-kernel-is-its-own-system` (accepted, Anthony's word) and holds cmp:nodes, cmp:schema, cmp:graph, cmp:provenance and cmp:identity — five modules that had been split across `sys:vocabulary` and `sys:store`, with identity in no system at all. Unlike the 2026-08-02 correction, the carving itself moved: a system exists now that did not exist before. It does not overturn this decision, it follows from it — a design-graph tool fundamentally IS a typed store of identified nodes, and that is one function, not two halves of two. The bisection was measured, not argued: it was the entire cause of a `sys:store` <-> `sys:vocabulary` cycle, while the modules themselves are acyclic (`fact:the-modules-are-acyclic-but-the-declared-subsystems-are-not`).

THE COUNT THAT WAS NOT WRONG, recorded so nobody "fixes" it twice: the 14 distinct cross-system pairs cited in `dec:maturity-restructuring-delta` are DIRECTED pairs; counted undirected the same 51 edges span 12.
